theme: Minnesota bur oaks, fringed acorn cups and deep roots: a small burr-cupped seed grows into a broad low guardian with four spreading root feet and three rounded-lobed leaf fans. The seed body becomes a rooted woody knot rather than a tall humanoid tree; no tools or costume.
habitat: Bur-oak savanna edges and deep-rooted woodland clearings.

sources.evidence: Native Minnesota oak inspiration; moving root anatomy and creature powers are original fiction.
sources.fantasy_extension: All powers, anatomy changes and discovery scenes are original fiction.

replacement_context: User requested forest wildlife in place of rejected weather families while retaining exactly220 active species. No encounter table or map event is changed.
